# Third-party assets and data provenance

D3 7.9.0: Copyright 2010–2023 Mike Bostock; ISC notice in `D3-LICENSE`.
Three.js 0.170.0: MIT notice in `three/LICENSE`.

Inter, Inter Tight, Space Grotesk and Fraunces are licensed under SIL OFL 1.1. Copyright and full license notices are in `licenses/*-OFL.txt`. Original asset URLs are recorded in `manifest.json`.

The data package contains supplied synthetic challenge records and aggregate simulator parameters. It does not contain external patient-level MIMIC or ARMD research tables. The supplied synthetic dataset does not include an explicit redistribution license; this product distribution is for private demonstration.

Delay summaries derive from Johnson et al. (2023), MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demo 2.2, PhysioNet, https://doi.org/10.13026/dp1f-ex47 . Its Open Database License v1.0 notice is retained at `licenses/MIMIC-IV-demo-2.2-LICENSE.txt`.

Return-gap and expected-resistance summaries derive from Nateghi Haredasht et al. (2025), Antibiotic Resistance Microbiology Dataset, Dryad, https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.jq2bvq8kp . Dryad identifies the 22 October 2025 release as CC0-1.0.

Browser RDF queries use Oxigraph; its distribution notices are in `../runtime/vendor/oxigraph/` in the generated site. Detailed source provenance is maintained in the product repository’s `docs/DATA-SOURCES.md`.
